title: Modern
description: Modern, in modern architecture cinematography, makes the room the thesis: glass planes, a designed void, a person small in Mies-or-Ando geometry. Production design first, and a loft with string lights is not this.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Alienation, wealth, a talk that should feel like a showroom: large planes, daylight as a blade, few objects, a palette of two greys and maybe one warm wood. Contemporary fashion is not the look.
The building is the other actor. It is the wrong tool in a cluttered kitchen, and the wrong tool if you count too many objects.
Modern is empty on purpose. Generic apartments fail.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Modern in film?
An architecture look: glass planes, designed void, the room as thesis, a person small in it. Not contemporary fashion, not a cluttered loft.
Modern vs Negative Space
Negative space is empty area in the frame. Modern is a building that produces that emptiness as law. You can have negative space in a field. This is glass and plane.
When should I use Modern?
Alienation, wealth, showroom talks. Skip cluttered kitchens and string lights.
How do I prompt Modern for AI image or video?
One figure, few objects, then: Modern architecture around [Subject], glass planes, a designed void, the room as the thesis. Daylight as a blade. Lock the camera.
